caption:
These are legal. Most employees just don't claim them.

Professional memberships: union fees, professional body subscriptions, industry association fees — deductible if the membership relates to your work. Keep the invoice.

Self-education: courses, workshops and seminars are deductible if they relate to your CURRENT job and help you maintain or improve the specific skills you use in it. Studying to get a different job or move into a new field? Not deductible.

Tools and equipment under $300: work-related item costing $300 or less? Claim it in full this year. No depreciation schedule. Keep the receipt.

The ATO won't remind you to claim these. We will.

Save this.

#australiantax #taxdeductions #taxreturn #workexpenses #paylesslegally
figures_checked: Union fees / professional memberships: deductible if work-related (ATO standard rule)
Self-education: deductible if relates to current job, not to get a new one (ATO standard rule)
Immediate deduction for work-related depreciating assets $300 or less (ATO mytax 2026 instructions, 8 Nov 2026)
